title: Keep prior sub-agent acceptance evaluators ineligible for independent-session reuse
outcome: Schema-1 history for sub-agent evidence recovery does not accidentally widen prior-target reuse eligibility.
acceptance: An independent-session request cannot reuse a prior sub-agent evaluator solely because it now has schema-1 history; the old target mode is checked and the prior child remains unchanged.

A behavioral regression covers a settled sub-agent prior delegation, an independent-session request with its reuseDelegationId, and a positive independent-session reuse control; typed-resubmit/rationale effects are assessed and documented.
